project_type: Laravel 12 CMS application with frontend and admin dashboard
build_system: Composer for PHP dependencies, npm for frontend assets. composer.json includes scripts: setup, dev, test, analyse, format, quality.
test_framework: Pest (PHPUnit-based) in tests/Feature and tests/Unit. Database: :memory: SQLite for testing.
build_command: composer install && npm ci && npm run build
test_command: php artisan test (Pest) or composer test. For quality: composer quality (runs format:test, analyse, test together)
verification_instructions: Run composer format:test (Pint), composer analyse (PHPStan with larastan), and php artisan test. All must pass.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None identified that require regeneration for these fixes.
environment_constraints: Project uses SQLite in development and testing. Windows compatibility required (exec() in FixStoragePermissions). Uses array cache driver in testing (no Redis/Memcached). Observer pattern already established in AppServiceProvider.
contribution_requirements: Code must pass PHPStan level configured in phpstan.neon if exists, Pint formatting (Laravel style), and existing Pest tests. New features should have tests. README states quality check with composer quality.
key_patterns: Observer pattern: models use booted() method to register cache clearing callbacks via static::saved() and static::deleted(). Observers registered in AppServiceProvider::boot(). Cache keys follow patterns like 'menu.location.{location}', 'settings.{group}', 'comments.pending.count', 'contacts.unread.count'. Migrations follow Laravel naming: YYYY_MM_DD_HHMMSS_description.php. Controllers use dependency injection for services. Error handling inconsistent: some use return back()->with('error'), some abort(), some throw exceptions.
directory_structure: app/Console/Commands (artisan commands), app/Http/Controllers/Admin and Frontend (controllers), app/Models (Eloquent models with observers), app/Observers (dedicated observer classes), app/Providers (service providers), app/Services (business logic), app/Traits (reusable traits), database/migrations (schema changes), database/seeders (data seeding), tests/Feature and tests/Unit (Pest tests), config/ (configuration files)
